Use case: stylized-concept. Production inventory sprite atlas for medieval fantasy RPG Altherya. Match the reference quality and rich dimensional hand-painted icons, warm gold highlights and natural materials. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows in a square 1024x1024 PNG with genuine alpha transparency. Sixteen equal invisible cells, one centered isolated small object per cell. Maintain at least 25px internal padding per cell. Do not cross cell edges. No backgrounds, grid lines, frames, labels, letters or readable text. The following French item names define what to depict, not text to draw. Abstract milestones should be represented by distinct small symbolic relics or medallions. Buildings and vehicles become collectible miniatures. Order left-to-right, row-by-row:
